site_tagline: Question banks and learning paths that parents share with every family, under a free licence.
found_none: No shared item matches this search.
bad_filter: One of the filters is not valid.
unavailable: The catalogue is unavailable for the moment. Please try again later.
footer_no_trackers: No account needed to browse, and no trackers.
item_download_help: For a family server without Internet access: import this file from the parent app. It carries the library's signature, which the family server checks.
item_not_found: This shared item is not in the catalogue.
account_why: To share or comment, choose a pseudonym. Your real name never appears.
account_anonymous: Browsing and importing need no account.
sign_in: Sign in with your Minute Jar account
sign_in_failed: The sign-in did not succeed. Please try again.
sign_in_strong: To open a library account, sign in again with a passkey, Google, Apple, Microsoft, or a password with a code from your authenticator app.
pseudonym_hint: 3 to 32 characters, without an at sign. Others see only this name. You can change it later.
statement_label: I am an adult and a parent, or I have parental responsibility for a child.
choice_same: This account, the one of my subscription
choice_same_operator: What the operator knows: that your pseudonym and your subscription belong to the same Minute Jar account. This lets you link them later to earn the Contributor discount and badge.
choice_separate: A separate account for the library
choice_separate_operator: What the operator knows: the e-mail address of this account, never shown. Your pseudonym is not joined to a subscription. If you are signed in with your subscription's account, sign out and sign in with another e-mail address first.
choice_others: What others see: your pseudonym only, never your name, e-mail address or card.
profile_same: On the Minute Jar account of your subscription.
profile_separate: On a Minute Jar account separate from any subscription.
refused_bad_pseudonym: This pseudonym is not valid: 3 to 32 characters, without an at sign.
refused_statement_required: Please confirm that you are an adult and a parent.
refused_choice_required: Please choose which Minute Jar account to use.
refused_strong_sign_in_required: Your sign-in is no longer recent enough. Please sign in again.
refused_account_exists: This Minute Jar account already has a library account.
refused_other: This could not be done. Please try again.
close_what: Your shared items stay published under their licence, with your pseudonym, and your pseudonym stays reserved: no one else can take it. You are signed out on every device.
close_kept: As the law asks of hosting providers, the e-mail address of your Minute Jar account is kept one year after your last share, then erased. It is never shown to anyone.
close_strong: To close your library account, sign in again first.
close_understood: I understand that my shared items stay published with my pseudonym.
closed: Your library account is closed. Your shared items stay published under your pseudonym.
refused_confirmation_required: Please confirm that you understand what closing your account does.
card_why: To share, a library account needs a verified card: it relies on your bank's check, so that someone answers for what is shared. The library never sees the card number and never shows your card.
card_subscription: Your subscription's card is used if it has one: you do not enter it again.
card_check: Otherwise, a zero-amount check: you enter a card at the payment provider, and your bank may ask you to confirm. Nothing is charged.
card_verified_subscription: Your card is verified, by your subscription's card, on {date}.
card_verified_check: Your card is verified, by a zero-amount check, on {date}.
card_pending: The check is not finished. Verify your card again to start a new one.
card_refused: Your bank or the payment provider refused the check. You can try again, with another card if needed.
card_sign_in_strong: To verify a card, sign in again with a passkey, Google, Apple, Microsoft, or a password with a code from your authenticator app.
moderation_intro: Reports and appeals waiting for a decision, oldest first. Every decision goes with its reasons to the author and to the reporter.
moderation_signed_out: Moderation is for the operator's moderators. Sign in with your Minute Jar account and a passkey.
moderation_not_moderator: This Minute Jar account is not a moderator. Only the operator names moderators.
moderation_passkey_title: Sign in again with your passkey
moderation_passkey: Moderating needs a sign-in with a passkey within the last 15 minutes.
moderation_empty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
moderation_decided: Decided. The author and the reporter are told.
moderation_effect_none: Nothing has changed for families yet.
moderation_effect_hidden: Hidden from new imports until a decision.
moderation_reasons: Reasons, sent to the author and the reporter
refused_reasons_required: Please write the reasons of the decision.
refused_same_moderator: Another moderator must decide an appeal against your own decision.
history_corrected: Corrected by the author with a new version
history_empty: Nothing has happened to this item in moderation.
figures_intro: The figures of the yearly transparency report, from the decisions log. They hold no personal data.
sharing_why: You share banks and learning paths from the parent app. Here you read the sharing terms, see what became of each share, and how many you may still share today.
terms_intro: Before your first share, you accept these terms:
terms_rights: You hold the rights to what you share: you made it, or it comes from free sources you name.
terms_compliant: It holds no personal data, nothing made by a child or taken from a school document, and nothing unsuitable for the ages it is for.
terms_answer: You answer for it. Only your pseudonym is shown; the library keeps your e-mail and card so that it can identify you if the law asks.
terms_licence: It is shared under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence: anyone may copy and improve it, keeping your pseudonym as its author.
terms_review: Every share is reviewed before it is public: it is published, held for a moderator, or refused with the reasons, question by question.
terms_accepted: You accepted the sharing terms. You can share from the parent app.
terms_changed: The sharing terms have changed since you accepted them: read them again before your next share.
refused_acceptance_required: Please tick the box to accept the sharing terms.
refused_outdated_sharing_terms: The sharing terms have just changed: please read them again.
quota_left: You may share {left} more today, out of {per_day} a day.
quota_reached: You have shared {per_day} items today, the most in a day: the review of every share has a cost. You may share again from {time}.
quota_why: Every share counts, whatever its outcome.
outcome_held: Held for a moderator, who will publish or refuse it.
outcome_refused: Refused. Correct it in the parent app and share it again:
moderation_held_reason: The rule the findings are about
outcome_publish_held: Publish: the findings do not hold
outcome_refuse_held: Refuse: the findings hold; the author reads the reasons
refused_reason_required: Please choose the rule the findings are about.
told_none: Nothing to tell you about your items.
told_to_correct: A family reported this. Correct it in the parent app and share a new version within 7 days, or a moderator will look at it.
told_upheld: A moderator upheld a report: the item was withdrawn, for these reasons:
told_rejected: A moderator rejected a report: the item stays, for these reasons:
told_appeal_maintained: Your appeal or the reporter's was decided: the decision stands, for these reasons:
told_appeal_reversed: Your appeal or the reporter's was decided: the decision was reversed, for these reasons:
told_appeal_label: If you disagree, appeal within six months: another moderator will look again.
told_appealed: Your appeal was received. Another moderator will decide it.
refused_statement_required_appeal: Please say why the decision should change.
refused_already_appealed: You have already appealed this decision.
refused_too_late: More than six months have passed since the decision: it can no longer be appealed.
comment_help: It shows under your pseudonym once reviewed. Comments are about this item: the library has no private messages.
comment_sign_in: To comment, sign in with your library account.
comment_held: Your comment waits for a moderator before it shows.
comment_refused: Your comment was not published, for these reasons:
refused_no_account: Open a library account first, with a pseudonym.
refused_card_required: Verify a card on your library account first.
refused_comment_quota_reached: You have written 20 comments today: you may comment again tomorrow.
reported_comment: Thank you: a moderator will look at this comment.
refused_unknown_comment: This comment is no longer shown.
moderation_comment_by: A comment by {pseudonym} on this item:
